text:
sophie: Heads-up  morning KPI snapshot showing launch-driven MQLs up 37% but pipeline and demo velocity flat. dash: https://app.redwood.com/dash/launch-perf
rahul: rough numbers?
sophie: quick paste:
```
7d window: MQLs|Demos|Opps
prior: 980|78|22
current: 1346|81|23
```
mike: looks like volume up, quality steady -> attribution noise. could be tracking, duplicate regs, or a messaging variant pulling low-intent signups.
ops: checked ingestion logs: sudden uptick in "referral=null" leads from the last push. suspect a missing utm_campaign on the new shortlink.
rahul: that would make paid and organic both show as "unknown" and inflate campaign numbers if we're backfilling by session.
dash-bot: [auto] Attribution alert: 29% of leads in last 24h have empty utm_campaign 1622000.
ops: i pulled a CRM export: ~400 new leads; 260 have lead.source='direct' and blank campaign fields.
sophie: ok let's not change budget until we validate. action: (1) ops check shortlink config and reprocess ingest (2) rahul run adjusted KPI view (campaign-only where utm_campaign != blank) (3) mike draft a short bench note explaining the discrepancy for Monday's KPI email
rahul: taking (2). will post the adjusted table in ~30m.
ops: shortlink missing campaign query param on redirect patching now and kicking an ETL reprocess. will upload corrected CSV here: https://uploads.redwood.com/tmp/launch-reprocess-3322114455.csv
mike: for benchmark narrative recommend a single-sentence callout: "Observed raw MQL uplift partially driven by shortlink tracking omission; adjusted campaign-attributed MQLs shown for decision-making." keep the headline conservative.
sophie: +1. also add a small note in the KPI deck with the reprocess timestamp and link to the CSV.
dash-bot: [reminder] Weekly KPI review in 45m 10:00am PT. attach adjusted metrics to the deck.
ops: reprocess started at 3322114499; ETA 8m. will post results and any edge cases.
rahul: uploaded adjusted view: https://app.redwood.com/dash/launch-perf?view=adjusted-utm
sophie: nice. once ops confirms reprocess we can decide on paid scaling. leaving this thread pinned for the KPI sync. :white_check_mark:
